name: The Decisive Points (1728) (C0028)

techniques.comment: Rejection of the treaty format: instead of a bilateral agreement – the tsar's "decisive" resolutions upon the hetman's requests, issued in the form of a decree. The autonomy ceased to be a party to a treaty and received its rules of existence from above.

Embedding the autonomy's finances into the imperial system: the revenues from the indukta (duty on imported goods) "were to be transferred to the tsar's treasury"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012), while the host treasury was managed by two general treasurers – a Ukrainian and an appointed Russian.

Complete diplomatic isolation of the autonomy: "Article 19 forbids the hetman relations with other countries. He was to acquaint the tsar's resident with letters received from abroad, forward their translations to the tsar's court, and meanwhile detain the envoys"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012).
